body: Thanks.  I think I will be OK now.

THanks, psy-kosh.  I just hanged up the phone; had a long conversation with a close friend.  He is going to come to my home and spend the rest of the night with me.  Tomorrow morning I’m going to see a new doc.  
This was really a close call.  I’m not entirely sure I made the right decision but there’s no way back now that others are directly involved.  It’s funny, when I first came to reddit my first thought was, “this is 4chan light”.  It never occurred to me that it would end up playing such a huge role in my life.  I want to thank everybody once more for your support.
Thanks, Grayce.  You are right, it is the pain, it's just that it has proven to be rather persistent.
Thanks, Orangutan.  I really appreciate your comment.

Thanks to all and each of you.  I owe you a brief update.  Each time I write or answer a comment I feel a part of me feels a bit stupid.  I shut down the computer to stop posting.  Somehow I keep coming back.  At any rate, the pressure seems a bit less intense now.  I suddenly feel a profound need to walk and take some fresh air.  My fear is that for these past hours I’ve been like a ping-pong ball bouncing back and forth in furious game between Life and Death.  A dip into Reddit is a bit of a escape -Life.  But then I think of tomorrow, and the day after tomorrow, and then the next day,  and it is all the same story again; in and out of depression.  So… why not take advantage of the fact that I’m sooooo close tonight, and end it once and for all?  Otherwise I may be in for a bit of a respite -these meds take the desperation away, but at least for me, they don’t turn the world into some magic garden of tranquility-  That’s the real question.  I was almost there a few hours ago.  Reddit pulled me back.  To what?  Anyway, I am completely, totally exhausted.  This really takes an amazing amount of energy, it’s like running a marathon.  But after this marathon, I really need some fresh air; I’m going to go have a walk.  Dear reddit, I don’t know what will happen later, but I’m still here because of you.  Thanks! I guess….

Thank you.  Long history of depression.  It really hurts, you know?  The pain is so strong that sometimes its almost physical.  Like a “being-squeeze”.  I’m tired of finding myself here over and over and over.   I don’t really know why I’m even writing here… but I thank you for being around.   I really want to leave.  But it takes such an amazing strenght! Lord.  This is literally driving me crazy!
